decisions.reason: As a flagship organic line with several variants that fits the firm's stated direction, it carries high visible commitment and sunk investment, so management is very likely to persist.

Although commitment is lower than for a flagship line, it still fits the organic expansion strategy and is close to the core business, making management more inclined to retain it and treat any weakness as temporary.

This multi-model product line is close to the established assortment and likely required meaningful launch effort, so in a growing market management would tend to continue rather than admit an early reversal.
